game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Camel Trail, a camel trail: the oasis keeper must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Edge Case Hunter: Find inputs like 0, empty lists, and negative numbers that break otherwise correct code.
theme: Sand Dunes – Camel Trail: a camel trail
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Route 9: verify the shipment flowchart, trace an extra input, identify the C history record, and assemble the source file. Then collect 2 crystal(s) and reach the beacon. In C, initialize file-scope int cargo to 24. Inside a nested block declare a float cargo set to half your shipment trace and print it to one decimal place. After that block, print the restored file-scope cargo as an integer.
controls: Write int main(void) with declarations, assignments, printf and braces. Movement calls moveRight(n), moveLeft(n), moveUp(n), moveDown(n) are game helpers from logicade.h. Run or Step verifies real map goals, printed values and global state in the documented safe C subset. Use the expedition panel to place flowchart symbols, enter the trace, read the archive record, and assemble the source blocks.
win_condition: Verify the preparation checks and complete the coded expedition.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Edge Case Hunter' (Week 9 slot 9), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Camel Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Place the shipment flowchart blocks and predict the extra input.
Read the historical record and assemble the C source file.
Write the scoped C program, collect the crystals, and reach the beacon.
source_player_objective: Reach the caravan wagon using at most 23 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The caravan wagon reached with actions_used <= 23.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 23 before the caravan wagon is reached, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Edge Case Hunter – Camel Trail Trial
hint: Work through the expedition checks in the sidebar. When writing C, declare the outer cargo before main and put the decimal cargo inside its own braces.
